study: Frozen Qwen3-VL on single-frame 3EED ordinary Validation, initial diagnostic
scope: 32 distinct point contents per target platform. Deterministic hash order round-robin over recordings of the exposed filtered ordinary manifest. One unaltered original utterance per physical frame. No score-, language- or annotation-dependent selection.
image_input: One full RGB image and the original referring expression, no class annotation, calibrated depth, crop, camera prompt or prior 3EED prediction. Two separate greedy tasks for a native 3D box and an independently elicited 2D box. No context passed between calls.
readout: Exactly one well-formed box per response. Retain format/missing/invalid/multiple-box failures in the denominator with zero task IoU. 3D xyz and extent in meters, angles per executable official renderer: pi times each in x,y,z order, Rz Ry Rx. Camera to raw lidar via inverse calibrated transform. Upright 7D box is the minimum-area horizontal enclosure of all eight corners and their vertical range. Also score full oriented 9D as a measurement sensitivity.
evaluation: Use strict oriented IoU >.25 and >.50, mIoU, platform and three-platform macro. Compare official frozen three-source 3EED and registered four-scale method on identical descriptions, average two incoming source models within target. Qwen assessed once per physical frame.
control: image_ray uses the independent 2D box center and true camera intrinsics with unchanged predicted optical depth. For true-depth arms project returns into central half-width/half-height of that 2D box, nearest depth per 4x4 pixel bin; immutable pixel-bin hash holds half the bins out. At least 5 fit bins required. Estimate center depth as median measured surface depth plus model's center-ray front-face offset. depth_only retains original Qwen ray, ray_depth uses the independent image ray. Mismatch uses an equally sized patch displaced by half image width in the same frame, preserving the real 2D ray. Unsupported modifications revert to their same-information starting box. No update of dimensions or pose in camera frame.
heldout: Check ray-box intersection hit fraction and median absolute first-face optical depth error on held-out true-region bins. Compare identical held-out rays and report misses separately, plus error on rays hitting both boxes.
diagnostic: After sealing, match auxiliary 2D or native projected rectangles to original annotated target projection and available distractors. Unique leading overlap >=.50 with margin >.10 certifies target/other; remainder unknown. Describe inventory limitations. Report signed and absolute depth, center, sorted dimension ratio, axial yaw; GT component substitution and exact target center/box are offline controls. Preserve all cases, matched outcomes and recording-level uncertainty.
decision: Separate newly acquired 2D bearing from actual LiDAR range. Consider further observability work only if matched returns improve task outcomes beyond the 2D ray alone and spatially mismatched returns. Scope limits from sample size, camera convention, inventory and recording count are reported.
